text:
Incident Bot: [pager] CDN-EDGE: elevated packet loss and TCP resets reported from POP eu-west-3 -> downstream ISPs. threshold 8% p50 crossed. paging on-call.
Sam: ack. seeing client telemetry spikes for streaming sessions and TLS handshake failures from cluster eu-west-3.
Rhea: loading POP dashboards now. backend egress counters show sustained 12-30% loss to 203.0.113.0/22 prefixes since 1772607400. Anycast route churn visible.
Carlos: quick sanity check: mtr to one affected IP: ```mtr -rwzbc 100 203.0.113.45``` results: many * and packet loss starting at hop 6 (peering fabric).
Eve: production alert: websocket session drops up 4x, API error 502 for some EU customers. Not global. I'm drafting status page.
Jun: checking DNS: no changes in our authoritative records, but recursive resolver telemetry shows increased latency and TCP retries when targeting eu-west-3 anycast addresses.
Sam: running tcpdump on edge egress: ```tcpdump -i eth1 host 203.0.113.45 and tcp and '(tcp[tcpflags] & (tcp-syn) != 0)';``` lots of retransmits and dup acks.
Carlos: provider ASN 64513 shows route flaps in our BGP stream. pushing a traceroute: ```traceroute -n 203.0.113.45
 1 10.0.0.1 0.4 ms
 2 198.51.200.17 3.6 ms
 3 198.51.200.33 5.1 ms
 4 203.0.114.2 50.2 ms
 5 * * *
 6 203.0.113.1 110.0 ms 112.3 ms 108.9 ms (packet loss starts)```
Rhea: correlating NetFlow -> most dropped traffic headed to upstream AS 64513 via POP interface gi0/3. Also BGP UPDATE churn spikes at 1772607405-1772607600.
OpsBot: auto-suggest: enable fallback anycast to eu-north-1, reweight peers for eu-west-3 prefixes.
Sam: action plan: 1) shift traffic away from eu-west-3 by lowering anycast preference and enabling eu-north-1/ eu-central-4 as higher priority; 2) request upstream BGP quiesce from ASN 64513 for problematic prefix; 3) open customer comms for affected segments.
Carlos: I'll open ticket with provider NOC (case 2026-5678) with BGP dumps and pcap attach. pinging contact now.
Jun: doing controlled shift now: adjusting router local-pref on route-map to prefer eu-north-1 for 203.0.113.0/22. will ramp over 5m.
Rhea: monitoring: after local-pref change, traffic started shifting at 1772608000. observed error reductions but still intermittent drops for ~10% of sessions.
Eve: posting initial status: "We are investigating degraded connectivity affecting some EU customers served from eu-west-3 POP. Traffic steering is in progress. No action required from customers." adding :hourglass_flowing_sand:.
Sam: performing streaming smoke test to eu-north-1 endpoints: curl and websocket look stable, p95 latency lower. starting to reroute more aggressively if stable for 10m.
Carlos: provider NOC responded: "We see congestion on our edge cluster, mitigating. No immediate blackhole. Will update."
Jun: next step: enable temporary connection draining on eu-west-3 to accelerate client re-resolve to other POPs. toggled TTL -> 30s for our anycast advertisement to encourage client reconnection.
Rhea: after draining and full shift at 1772608600, packet loss on eu-west-3 egress dropped from median 22% -> 4%. overall API 5xx reduced from 11% -> 2.1%.
Eve: updating status: "Mitigation underway. Traffic being steered away from affected POP. Partial recovery observed." pinned.
Carlos: note for dedicated customers: those on private peering (DirectConnect + Dedicated) were routed via private backbone and had minimal impact. marking customers: AcmeCorp, DataStreamInc in the impact doc.
Sam: preparing rollback/runbook: criteria to rollback: upstream reports stable for 2h and BGP withdraws stop for 30m. otherwise keep steering in place.
Jun: scheduling NetOps follow-up with provider for full RCA. adding BGP update samples 1772607380-1772609000 to incident artifact store.
Rhea: handing over to Carlos for night coverage at 1772609800. Carlos will be primary for any provider comms and post-incident actions.
Carlos: got it. I'll consolidate logs, pcap, and NetFlow into the postmortem. Tentative postmortem time: 1772624000 (48h).
OpsBot: incident recorded. severity adjusted to Sev3 (regional impact with mitigation). owner: Carlos.
Eve: final status update draft to customers: "Resolved: traffic has been rerouted and we see partial recovery. We will keep steering until upstream confirms stability; follow-up postmortem scheduled." ready to send after ops confirmation.
Sam: leaving commands used in incident doc: ```conf t
route-map PREF_EU permit 10
 set local-preference 50
exit
clear ip bgp 203.0.113.0/22 route-map PREF_EU```
Carlos: provider sent final note: "we routed additional capacity and applied mitigations to the fabric at 1772609200, monitoring. No further instability seen in our telemetry."
Jun: monitoring for 1h. if stable, we'll plan controlled return to normal anycast weights.
Rhea: closing public updates; will reopen thread if regression. thanks team. :white_check_mark:
